regions.full_page: Thanks. . . Russell, James - 48 - presbiterian - very peculiar lame leg and foot - could sleep very little from continual pain for three years. Dr's in Grace Hospital sent him home as one hopeless case ..... June 2nd A Catholic neighbor, Mrs. Eby, enrolled him June 2nd (3) in Ser. Masses ... Two weeks To-night. Just a week lat- er he walked and is here Tonight with wife and Cath. friend ..... Enrolls perpetually - O.K. Mr. Russell's ancesters .. line away back presbiterian Ministers.
